Nikola "NiKo" Kovač (formerly known as NiKolinho and nIKOLINHO) (born February 16, 1997) is a Bosnian Serb professional Counter-Strike 2 player, a former professional Counter-Strike: Global Offensive player and a former semi-professional Counter-Strike player who plays for Team Falcons. He is Nemanja "huNter-" Kovač's cousin.

NiKo is widely regarded as one of the greatest riflers of all time and has been in contention for the title of the best player in the world at multiple periods throughout his career. He has also been included in HLTV's Top 20 Players of the Year ranking a record 10 times, all consecutively since 2016, peaking at #2 in 2017 and 2023. [1]

Records

[edit]
  • He is the first Bosnian to make it to HLTV's Top 20 Players of the Year Ranking.
  • Most appearances in HLTV's Top 20 Players of the Year ranking (10).
  • Most consecutive appearances in HLTV's Top 20 Players of the Year ranking (10).
  • Most top 5 appearances in HLTV's Top 20 Players of the Year ranking (7).
    • Tied with ZywOo.
  • Tied with donk for the highest achieved rating at a "Big Event" (1.70). He did so at ESL One: New York 2017. [32]
  • Holds the record for kills in a map at a Major after scoring 52 against FlipSid3 Tactics at MLG Columbus 2016. [33]
  • He is the first player to win multiple HLTV MVP awards in three consecutive years.
  • Previously held the record for kills in regulation at a big event or any match between top teams on LAN with 40 against Team Liquid at ECS Season 4 Finals. [34] His record was later taken over by KRIMZ who dropped 44 against MIBR at ESL Pro League Season 10: Finals. [35]
  • He and FalleN are the first players to make a Major final with 3 different organizations. He did so with FaZe Clan at ELEAGUE Major: Boston 2018, G2 Esports at PGL Major Stockholm 2021, and Team Falcons at IEM Cologne Major 2026.
  • He is the Major winner who had to wait the longest to get his first title: IEM Cologne Major 2026 was his 17th Major.
  • First Bosnian to win a Major, doing so at IEM Cologne Major 2026.
